description: Multi-source bench (stage 0.2). fitness_db split across two MCP servers: 'sales' reads ms_fixture_sales (Sales, SaleDetails), 'crm' reads ms_fixture_crm (Customers, Products, ServiceTickets). Ground truth from one query against the full fitness_db (truth_sql). A question passes when every check passes: a 'number' check finds a number in the answer within tol (relative); a 'text' check finds the string (case-insensitive). 'needs' says which servers the answer requires.
fixture_note: The fixture tables hold ~100 rows each, so the question that exceeds the 5,000-row combine cap unless the filter is pushed down (plan 0.2) cannot be built here; it is covered by the DAB two-server run (plan 0.4 / R11).

questions.question: Which 5 customer states generated the most sales revenue (sum of the sale total amounts), and how much did the top one generate?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT TOP 5 c.State, SUM(s.TotalAmount) FROM fitness_db.Sales s JOIN fitness_db.Customers c ON s.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: Who is the customer (first and last name) with the highest total purchase amount, and what is that total?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT TOP 1 c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(s.TotalAmount) FROM fitness_db.Sales s JOIN fitness_db.Customers c ON s.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

questions.question: Which product type sold the most units (sum of quantities on sale line items), and how many units?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.ProductType, SUM(d.Quantity) FROM fitness_db.SaleDetails d JOIN fitness_db.Products p ON d.ProductID=p.ProductID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: Which 3 brands generated the most revenue from sale line items (quantity times unit price)? Give the revenue of the top brand.
questions.truth_sql: SELECT TOP 3 p.Brand, SUM(d.Quantity*d.UnitPrice) FROM fitness_db.SaleDetails d JOIN fitness_db.Products p ON d.ProductID=p.ProductID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: What is the total purchase amount (sum of sale totals) of all customers who have a service ticket with status 'Open'?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT SUM(s.TotalAmount) FROM fitness_db.Sales s WHERE s.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM fitness_db.ServiceTickets WHERE Status='Open')

questions.question: Which product (by name) generated the most revenue from sale line items (quantity times unit price), and how much?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.ProductName, SUM(d.Quantity*d.UnitPrice) FROM fitness_db.SaleDetails d JOIN fitness_db.Products p ON d.ProductID=p.ProductID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: How many distinct products with a stock quantity below 20 have been sold at least once?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.ProductID) FROM fitness_db.SaleDetails d JOIN fitness_db.Products p ON d.ProductID=p.ProductID WHERE p.StockQuantity<20

questions.question: What is the average sale amount for customers located in the state NY?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT AVG(s.TotalAmount) FROM fitness_db.Sales s JOIN fitness_db.Customers c ON s.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.State='NY'

questions.question: Which product type has the most service tickets, and how many units of that product type were sold?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT p.ProductType, COUNT(*) FROM fitness_db.ServiceTickets t JOIN fitness_db.Products p ON t.ProductID=p.ProductID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC; units: SELECT SUM(d.Quantity) FROM fitness_db.SaleDetails d JOIN fitness_db.Products p ON d.ProductID=p.ProductID WHERE p.ProductType='Weights'

questions.question: What is the total sales revenue from customers located in JP?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT SUM(s.TotalAmount) FROM fitness_db.Sales s JOIN fitness_db.Customers c ON s.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.State='JP'

questions.question: How many sales were made by customers located in UK?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fitness_db.Sales s JOIN fitness_db.Customers c ON s.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.State='UK'

questions.question: How many service tickets currently have the status 'Open'?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fitness_db.ServiceTickets WHERE Status='Open'

questions.question: What was the total sales amount (sum of sale totals) in 2023?
questions.truth_sql: SELECT SUM(TotalAmount) FROM fitness_db.Sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SaleDate)=2023
